name: Indomie Instant Noodles
ingredients_raw: Refined wheat flour (Maida), Edible vegetable oil (Refined palm oil (E319)), Salt, Acidity regulators (INS 452, INS 501, INS 500), Thickener (INS 412), Colour (INS 101), Sugar, Salt, Flavour enhancers (INS 621, INS 631, INS 627), Garlic, Onion, Colour caramel 1-plain (INS 150a), Anti-caking agent (INS 551).
